title.narrative: Advancing Digital Integration: Enhancing Ukraine's State Register of Movable Properties through Museum Digitization

description.narrative: This project aims to build on previous successes and lessons learned from UNESCO's engagement since the escalation of the war in Ukraine. The primary objectives include: 1. Capacity Building: Enhancing the skills of identified museum institutions and professionals to transition their object inventories into the State Registry. This includes the provision of capacity building for identified museum professionals at the Lviv Culture Hub, established by UNESCO. 2. Mobile support team: Based on the capacity building activities, the creation of four mobile support teams to roll-out support to museum professionals across the country to digitize their inventory and document their objects. 3. Pilot Projects Implementation: Conducting a series of pilot projects to complete or develop selected inventories and to digitize individual data sets of movable cultural property, museum collections, historic archives, documents, and existing inventories (including intangible cultural heritage). The digitization process will address various scenarios: a. Standardizing already digitized inventory cards/entries to provide centralized access to decentralized inventories. b. Converting paper cards into digital data. c. Undertaking full digitization where no pre-existing inventory records and collections exist. The project not only aims to safeguard Ukraine's movable cultural properties during the ongoing war but also seeks to lay the groundwork for sustainable cultural heritage management. By digitizing and standardizing the inventory process, this initiative will enhance accessibility and interoperability with other governmental databases and align with international digital heritage standards.
